data.name: OutputOpenDescription
data.value: Opens the WPF output window on the selected monitor.

data.name: OutputCloseDescription
data.value: Closes the output window. While live, you are asked to confirm.

data.name: LiveGoDescription
data.value: Sends the selected item to the live output.

data.name: LiveGoAndNext
data.value: Go live and select next item

data.name: LiveGoAndNextDescription
data.value: Sends the selected item live and moves the selection straight to the next item in the queue.

data.name: LivePreviewToOutputClearBlack
data.value: Send preview to output and clear black

data.name: LivePreviewToOutputClearBlackDescription
data.value: Global F7: copies the preview item to the output and turns off the black screen.

data.name: LivePreviewToOutputDescription
data.value: Global F8: copies the preview item to the output. While live, the current preview is sent again.

data.name: LiveNextDescription
data.value: While live, moves to the next output slide or verse; at the end, goes on to the next output item when auto-advance is on.

data.name: LivePreviousDescription
data.value: While live, moves back one output slide or verse; at the start, goes back to the previous output item when auto-advance is on.

data.name: LiveBlackDescription
data.value: Switches the current live output to a black screen.

data.name: LiveClearDescription
data.value: Clears the lyrics and content and shows only the background (not the same as the black screen).

data.name: LiveRestartDescription
data.value: Shows the current live item again from its first verse or slide.

data.name: LiveRefreshDescription
data.value: Redraws the output screen (recovers from display glitches).

data.name: LiveRestoreDescription
data.value: Goes back from hidden, black or clear to what was shown before.

data.name: LiveAutoRotateDescription
data.value: Changes verses or slides automatically at a set interval while live.

data.name: CaptionToggleDescription
data.value: Shows the camera captions on the camera and OBS or hides them (once the captions tab is open).

data.name: CaptionTabDescription
data.value: Switches the preview column between the preview and the captions tab (opens the captions the first time).

data.name: WorshipDuplicateItemDescription
data.value: Duplicates the selected worship list item and adds the copy right after it.

data.name: WorshipMoveItemUpDescription
data.value: Moves the selected worship list item up one place.

data.name: WorshipMoveItemDownDescription
data.value: Moves the selected worship list item down one place.

data.name: WorshipMoveItemToTopDescription
data.value: Moves the selected worship list item to the top.

data.name: WorshipMoveItemToBottomDescription
data.value: Moves the selected worship list item to the bottom.

data.name: WorshipQuickSaveDescription
data.value: Saves the current worship list under its session name (with no name yet, set one in the worship list manager).

data.name: WorshipSelectLiveItemDescription
data.value: Moves the selection back to the item now live (after looking ahead in the preview).

data.name: WindowLibraryDescription
data.value: Opens the song library (search, copy, move and delete songs).

data.name: WindowBibleDescription
data.value: Opens the Bible window (versions and verse search).

data.name: WindowManageBibleVersionsDescription
data.value: Renames Bible versions (the text stays as it is).

data.name: WindowSearchDescription
data.value: Opens song search and the usage report.

data.name: WindowImportExportDescription
data.value: Opens the import and export window (text, XML, DB, RTF, HTML).

data.name: WindowExternalFilesDescription
data.value: Opens the window to copy or move external files.

data.name: WindowManageListsDescription
data.value: Opens the window to save and load worship lists.

data.name: AddExternalFileDescription
data.value: Adds a PowerPoint or media file to the worship list.

data.name: ImportLegacyWorshipListDescription
data.value: Opens an older Axicultus worship list file (.esw) and brings it into the current worship list (songs are filled from the library lyrics).
